instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Tell me the exact seconds a passage I quote starts and ends in a recording, read a recording's words back as timed sentences, or keep its word times in the one file shape my plans cut from", and give it step.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:find-a-spoken-passage-in-word-times and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Works on a recording's word-time file (a words list of {text, start, end}, the {t, start, end} words the transcription tool writes, or Whisper's segments with words), in the folder the person let this tool change.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: record:setting (records:read).

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and this kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
